description: Returns the address of the Verateca order page for one of its three paid services (quick, full, review), with the price and currency the site shows for the country and a one-line description. The tool takes no payment and creates no order; the order page asks its own questions and takes payment there.

country.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of the person. Limits of this country come first. Default US.

goals.description: Optional goals to preselect on the order page (quick: 1, full: up to 3; ignored for review). They travel sealed, not in plain words.

service.description: quick: up to three products for one goal; full: one set for up to three goals; review: a written review by a Verateca specialist.

name: get_selection_link
title: Get the order page address
